content:
Anya: quick sync — we need to lock the minimum observability surface for the Console launch next month. my proposal: per-route cost dashboard, top-10 error slices, and tracing hooks for inference path (token-level latency + kv-cache misses).
Mike: +1 for focusing backend instrumentation first. frontend UX can be iterated later.
Sara: can we scope tracing hooks to a sampling approach? full traces on canary only, 1% globally. avoids perf hit.
Anya: yes — canary=100% trace, prod sample=1%. also want a ‘cost per generated token’ widget by model+route.
Liam: cost metric depends on batching and quantization profiles. we need to attach config tags to telemetry: model.version, quant.profile, batch.size.
Sara: adding tags is easy on server side, but we should standardize key names. propose: model, model_version, quant_profile, batch_size. ok?
Anya: sounds good. can we include a small JSON snippet for the tracing tag payload?
Sara: sure — use this in logs/traces:
```
{
  "model": "rwkv-7b",
  "model_version": "v3.2.1",
  "quant_profile": "int8-q4_0",
  "batch_size": 8,
  "route": "/api/generate"
}
```
Mike: for error analytics, we need classification at ingestion: user-facing vs internal. user-facing errors should be surfaced as top-level slices in dashboard. internal errors go to infra-only view.
Jen: from CS — customers want drilldown to a specific request id and the failing prompt. ensure PII scrubbed but prompt hash + request id available.
Liam: agreed. add prompt_hash and request_id tags. store prompt text only for eval/debug mode behind gating.
Anya: launch criteria (MVP): 1) per-route cost dashboard showing last 7 days and 30-day trend; 2) tracing hooks with sampling; 3) top-10 error slices with first-class filters (model, route, region); 4) request-level drilldown for paged incidents with request_id and prompt_hash.
Sara: implementation notes — backend work: add telemetry tags, trace exporter, sampling flag. frontend: dashboard panels + table view. I estimate 2 sprints backend, 1 sprint frontend.
Mike: SLOs we should monitor during rollout: token latency p50/p95, request success rate, trace ingestion errors. set temporary alert thresholds conservative to avoid noise.
Anya: scope cuts if needed: postpone interactive query builder and complex saved views. keep export CSV simple.
Jen: CS will prepare a small customer-facing changelog and include opt-in beta for deep request logs.
deploy-bot: canary deployed to us-west-2 at 2354010000 :rocket:
Anya: next steps — Sara to scope telemetry PR and tag names by EOD, Mike to draft alert thresholds, Liam to add cost calc prototype. we'll reconvene Thu 10am to lock final acceptance gates. :ok_hand:
